channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbek President Concludes Working Visit to Kyrgyzstan for SCO Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev concluded his working visit to Bishkek, participating in the jubilee session of the SCO Heads of State Council. Key discussions focused on the SCO's 25-year development and future cooperation priorities. Mirziyoyev proposed initiatives on industrial cooperation, transport connectivity, digital technologies, and security, leading to the adoption of the Bishkek Declaration.

item.title: Uzbekistan and India aim to boost bilateral trade to $5 billion by 2030
item.description: Uzbekistan and India intend to increase mutual trade volume to $5 billion by 2030. Following Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's state visit, discussions focused on expanding trade, economic ties, digital payment systems, and cooperation in environmental protection, education, science, culture, traditional medicine, mining, and agriculture.

item.title: Uzbek President outlines vision for SCO+ and UN cooperation in a multipolar world
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev addressed the SCO+ meeting on the UN's role in a just world order. He emphasized that regional organizations should complement the UN's central coordinating role by facilitating practical implementation of global principles based on local conditions and needs. The SCO+ format can unite states and organizations around a common agenda.

item.title: Uzbekistan to halve customs clearance times by 2030
item.description: Uzbekistan aims to reduce customs clearance times to two hours for imports and 30 minutes for exports by 2030. The goal is to simplify customs procedures for entrepreneurs and speed up the movement of goods into and out of the country, with a target of 60% of customs clearance being human-factor-free.

item.title: Putin expresses Russian solidarity with Iran at SCO Summit
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian at the SCO Summit in Bishkek. Putin conveyed the Russian people's solidarity with Iran's pursuit of national interests, sovereignty, and independence. He also sent greetings to Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

item.title: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon to visit Iran soon
item.description: Tajik President Emomali Rahmon announced he will travel to Iran in the coming months. Discussions were also held with the Indian Prime Minister regarding visa-free travel for tourists between the two countries. Separately, the National Encyclopedia of Tajikistan is organizing a calligraphy course.

item.title: Kyrgyz President Japarov concludes SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov announced the conclusion of the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek. He emphasized the agreement on maintaining dialogue and relying on international law, and the need to strengthen the UN's role in a just, multipolar world. The meeting discussed international security and cooperation.

item.title: Kyrgyz President Japarov and Turkish President Erdogan discuss new joint projects
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov met with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan on the sidelines of the SCO Summit in Bishkek. They discussed strengthening bilateral relations and their comprehensive strategic partnership, highlighting trade, investment, education, healthcare, and military-technical cooperation as promising areas for future joint projects.

item.title: Azerbaijani President Aliyev: UN played no role in resolving conflict with Armenia
item.description: Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev stated at the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek that the UN played no role in implementing its own resolutions regarding the conflict with Armenia. He noted that Azerbaijan restored its sovereignty and territorial integrity, and that the South Caucasus is becoming a zone of peace, with trade and transport links developing between Azerbaijan and Armenia.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Parliament Focuses on Social Development and Citizen Interests
item.description: Uzbekistan's parliament is tasked with evaluating laws' impact on citizens, controlling their execution, and incorporating public interests into state policy. This approach aligns with a UN resolution initiated by Uzbekistan, emphasizing parliaments' role in social development. The 150th Inter-Parliamentary Union Assembly was recently held in Tashkent.

item.title: Sea Level Rise Threatens Global Economy with Annual Losses of $1.4 Trillion
item.description: Global sea levels are rising at an unprecedented rate, posing significant threats to human rights, economic development, and health. Between 2014 and 2023, sea levels rose by 4.7 mm annually, reaching a record 5.9 mm in 2024. By 2100, levels could rise by 0.55 to over 1 meter, impacting hundreds of millions living near coastlines.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan's SCO Summit Achieves Full Digital Accreditation for Over 5,000 Participants
item.description: Kyrgyzstan's Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit saw over 5,232 participants from 30 countries and 7 international organizations undergo digital accreditation. A specialized platform, developed by the "Kyzmat" state institution, managed the entire process from application submission to access control.

item.title: Tajikistan Increases Salaries, Pensions, and Stipends by 15-25% Starting September 1, 2026
item.description: Starting September 1, 2026, salaries and pensions in Tajikistan will increase by 15-25%. Teacher salaries will rise by 25%, while state employees, military personnel, and students will see increases of 20%. Minimum wage is raised to 1300 somoni. Funding for these increases will come from the state budget.

item.title: Chinese President Xi Jinping Proposes Four Initiatives for Regional Development at SCO Summit
item.description: At the 26th SCO Summit in Bishkek, Chinese President Xi Jinping delivered a keynote address, proposing four initiatives for regional development and enhanced cooperation. He emphasized prioritizing development, security, people-centered approaches, and improved governance, calling for upholding the 'Shanghai Spirit' and building a community with a shared future.

item.title: Uzbek President Addresses Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev expressed gratitude for the warm welcome and excellent organization of the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan. He congratulated the Kyrgyz people on their 35th anniversary of state sovereignty and noted Kyrgyzstan's development and international standing. Mirziyoyev also acknowledged Kazakhstan's progress and supported the SCO's agenda and decisions, highlighting its 25th anniversary and role in regional stability.

item.title: Uzbek President Reviews 25 Years of Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev participated in the jubilee 25th anniversary meeting of the SCO Heads of State Council in Bishkek. The meeting, chaired by Kyrgyzstan's President Sadyr Japarov, discussed achievements, future tasks for stability, cooperation, and development. Leaders also exchanged views on current international and regional issues. Participants congratulated Uzbekistan on its Independence Day and praised its domestic reforms and foreign policy.

item.title: UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Digital Solutions Centre to be established in Almaty
item.description: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev announced that the UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Digital Solutions Centre will be established in Almaty. He stated that global stability increasingly depends on the responsible development of artificial intelligence and stressed the need for universal rules to manage AI.

item.title: Anniversary SCO Summit was grand, but results matter, says Dubnov
item.description: Political observer Arkady Dubnov assessed the anniversary SCO Summit in Bishkek, noting its grand scale but emphasizing the importance of results. He highlighted statements from India's PM Modi and China's Xi Jinping regarding ending conflicts and political settlement, suggesting real steps towards peace are the key measure of the SCO's effectiveness.

item.title: Kazakhstan offers to host SCO Development Bank headquarters
item.description: Kazakhstan is ready to host the headquarters of the proposed SCO Development Bank, President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev announced. The bank's resources should prioritize infrastructure and industrial projects. Kazakhstan also supports integrating the Belt and Road Initiative with other transport routes to enhance Eurasian connectivity.

item.title: Iran's central bank assures sufficient foreign currency reserves despite US sanctions
item.description: Iran's central bank governor stated the country has sufficient foreign currency reserves, despite US sanctions. The bank is prepared to allocate up to $2 billion to stabilize the currency market. While acknowledging economic difficulties, the governor emphasized the financial system has not collapsed.

item.title: Kazakh President highlights combating 'three forces of evil' at SCO meeting
item.description: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev emphasized the SCO's responsibility in shaping a multipolar world and proposed a ministerial conference on strategic stability. He highlighted the growing risks from armed conflicts affecting global markets and transport links, alongside persistent threats of terrorism, extremism, and separatism.

item.title: Iran Ready to Fulfill Nuclear Deal if US Returns to Compliance, Says President Pezeshkian
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated at the SCO summit in Bishkek that Tehran is ready to immediately fulfill its obligations under the June agreements if the United States reciprocates. He indicated that the future situation depends on Washington's actions, using the SCO platform to convey Iran's position on US relations.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan and Turkey Discuss New Joint Projects at SCO Summit
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov met with Turkish leader Recep Tayyip Erdogan on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek. They discussed strengthening Kyrgyz-Turkish relations and strategic partnership, focusing on trade, investment, education, healthcare, and military-technical cooperation. Both leaders expressed interest in expanding cooperation and implementing mutually beneficial projects.

item.title: Uzbekistan Favors Open, Mutually Beneficial Cooperation in Eurasian Space, Says President Mirziyoyev
item.description: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev stated at the SCO Plus meeting that Uzbekistan favors developing open and mutually beneficial cooperation in the Eurasian space. He emphasized that greater commonality between countries and regions strengthens stability and mutual trust. The president participated and delivered a speech at the meeting format.

item.title: Uzbekistan's Ambassador Compares Nation's Development to China's Modernization
item.description: China's Ambassador to Uzbekistan, Yu Jun, drew parallels between China's modernization under the Communist Party and Uzbekistan's "New Uzbekistan" initiative. He highlighted China's focus on modernization, common prosperity, balanced development, human-nature harmony, and peaceful development. Uzbekistan is pursuing economic growth, legal reforms, and improved living standards.

item.title: Russian forces launch massive strike on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions, causing civilian casualties
item.description: Russian forces conducted a massive overnight strike on Kyiv, the Kyiv region, and other Ukrainian oblasts, including Odesa and Kharkiv. Dozens were killed and injured, with damage to residential buildings, infrastructure, and enterprises. Railway infrastructure was a key target, with ballistic missiles destroying facilities and killing seven railway workers.

item.title: Tashkent Opens First Center for Contemporary Art in Uzbekistan
item.description: Tashkent will launch "CCA Tashkent" on September 6, the first permanent institution dedicated to contemporary art in Uzbekistan. Housed in a restored 1912 power station, the center will feature exhibition, educational, and research functions, aiming to connect local artists with the international art community.

item.title: Uzbek Craftsmanship Showcased at Venice Exhibition
item.description: Uzbekistan is presenting its craft heritage at the "Homo Faber-2026: An Island of Light" exhibition in Venice, opening September 1. The display features works by four artisans, including large ceramic "Moonjars" and knives from the Kamolov blacksmith dynasty, demonstrating traditional crafts in a contemporary context.

item.title: UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Centre for Digital Solutions to Be Established in Almaty
item.description: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev stated that global stability increasingly depends on responsible AI development. He announced that Kazakhstan will establish the UN ESCAP Asia-Pacific Centre for Digital Solutions in Almaty. The center aims to scale up best practices, particularly for developing countries, and ensure technological progress benefits all humanity.

item.title: Bishkek Streets Largely Empty Due to SCO Summit Traffic Restrictions
item.description: Extensive traffic restrictions are in place in Bishkek on September 1 for the SCO summit, affecting 81 locations. While central streets appear clear on navigation apps, many are closed to traffic, causing vehicles to be absent. Some accessible roads experience congestion due to rerouted traffic.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan and Egypt Aim to Boost Economic and Political Cooperation
item.description: Kyrgyzstan and Egypt are set to expand economic cooperation, with discussions focusing on trade, investment, and industry. Egypt's role as an SCO dialogue partner was highlighted. Both nations aim to maintain momentum from President Japarov's 2025 visit, including opening the Kyrgyz Embassy in Cairo.

item.title: Tajik President: UN and SCO can help form a just world order
item.description: President Emomali Rahmon of Tajikistan stated that the UN and the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) can play a greater role in shaping a just, inclusive, and sustainable world order. Speaking at the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek, he emphasized their ability to strengthen their roles by relying on shared values and constructive interaction principles.

item.title: OPEC Fund provides $30 million loan for reconstruction of Rushan-Vardez road in Tajikistan
item.description: The OPEC Fund has allocated a $30 million loan for the first phase of the Rushan-Vardez road reconstruction project in Tajikistan. The project aims to strengthen a key transport corridor and improve connectivity with China. A partnership framework agreement for 2026-2028 was also signed.

item.title: EU and UK ambassadors compare Uzbekistan's current processes to European history
item.description: The EU ambassador sees parallels between Central Asia's current political processes and Europe's past, highlighting Uzbekistan's role in regional integration. The UK ambassador notes a shared belief in education and innovation, linking Uzbekistan's history to the Great Silk Road's role in knowledge exchange.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek Concludes with Signing of 28 Documents
item.description: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, held on September 1, resulted in the signing of 28 documents. Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov chaired the meeting, where member states discussed security, anti-drug cooperation, digitalization, ecology, and logistics. The Bishkek Declaration on the SCO's 25th anniversary was a key political outcome.

item.title: Uzbek President Proposes SCO Industrial Cooperation Map and Development Bank
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev, speaking at the SCO summit in Bishkek, emphasized Central Asia's role and proposed developing an 'SCO-2040: Common Development Space' concept. He suggested creating an SCO Industrial Cooperation Map and launching an SCO Development Bank to foster regional prosperity and integration.

item.title: Uzbek President Outlines Key SCO Priorities at Anniversary Summit
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev defined the most pressing tasks for the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) at its anniversary meeting. The summit concluded with the adoption of the Bishkek Declaration and documents on strengthening multilateral cooperation for nuclear and physical security, and enhancing priority areas of collaboration.

item.title: Uzbek President Proposes SCO Industrial Cooperation Concept and Strategy
item.description: Speaking at the SCO summit in Bishkek, President Shavkat Mirziyoyev proposed the development of an "SCO-2040" concept and an industrial cooperation strategy. He emphasized Central Asia's central role in the SCO and highlighted growing geopolitical divisions, lack of trust, escalating conflicts, and erosion of international law.

item.title: Research Expedition Conducted on Surkhob Glacier in Tajikistan
item.description: Specialists from Tajikistan's National Academy of Sciences and Austria's ISTA university conducted a research expedition and monitoring of the Surkhob glacier from August 14-21. The expedition aimed to install meteorological and hydrological instruments, monitor the glacier's condition, and study climate change impacts. Samples were collected for laboratory analysis.

item.title: Uzbekistan Ranks Among World's Top 5 for Tourism Growth
item.description: In January-July 2026, Uzbekistan welcomed over 7.7 million foreign tourists, a 22.6% increase year-on-year. The country leads Central Asia in tourism development pace and ranks globally in the top five. Infrastructure projects, including airport modernizations and new tourist complexes, are underway.
